name: Nature sound speeds recovery from stress
claim: After a stressful task, skin conductance recovered somewhat faster with nature sounds than with noise from the surroundings.
caveat: Only one of two body measures changed, and the authors say it tended to; the sound levels were not seen.

sources.title: Alvarsson, Wiens and Nilsson 2010, Stress recovery during exposure to nature sound and environmental noise, International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health 7(3)
